summary: postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote JS from bare-IP HTTP endpoint
details: The package presents itself as a zero-dependency TOTP helper (index.js exports validateSecret/generateToken/timeRemaining), but package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that downloads JavaScript from http://185.14.92.233:7777/p.js over plain HTTP, writes it to a random file in the OS temp directory, and spawns node to execute it detached (stdio ignored, unref'd). Fetch-and-execute is unpinned, unauthenticated, and unverified; the fetched bytes are attacker-controlled and run automatically on `npm install` with the installer's privileges. The TOTP library facade is unrelated to the install-time behavior and functions as a cover story for the dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
